facts.content: Patient has a history of Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS).
Patient takes Mebeverine 200 mg three times a day.
Patient is allergic to Clindamycin.
Patient denies any significant family health issues.
Patient lives with friends and works as a support worker.

facts.content: Patient consumes approximately one glass of wine per week and is a non-smoker.
Assessment indicates acute cystitis with hematuria.
facts.source_text: 1) Acute cystitis with hematuria — 6 days dysuria, malodorous urine, suprapubic pain; afebrile; no flank pain; tolerating PO

facts.content: Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS) is stable on Mebeverine.
Prescribed empiric antibiotics for 3 days; to start as soon as possible.
facts.source_text: Empiric abx x3 days (Rx sent to requested pharmacy); start ASAP

facts.content: Recommended hydration of 2.5–3 liters per day.
Optional treatments include cranberry juice and OTC urinary alkalinizing sachets.
facts.source_text: Optional: cranberry juice; OTC urinary alkalinizing sachets

facts.content: Advised to obtain a thermometer and monitor temperature.
Advised to seek care if symptoms worsen or do not improve after completing antibiotics.
facts.source_text: Safety-net: seek care if worsening pain, new back/loin pain, fever, rigors, vomiting, urinary retention, or no improvement after completing abx; discuss if recurrent episodes

facts.content: Allow approximately 1 hour before collecting prescription from pharmacy.
facts.source_text: Pickup: allow ~1 hour before pharmacy collection (Knightsbridge Practice)

facts.content: Continue Mebeverine 200 mg three times a day for IBS.
